Reconstruct the covered areas as uninterrupted snowy landscape with naturally continuing soft blue snow shadows and the existing trail of footprints continuing toward the foreground. Preserve the existing composition, character identity, outfit, pose, scale and central placement, snowy trees on the left, mountain horizon, cloud shapes and blue winter sky. Keep the soft 2D anime/visual-novel background art style, rather than photorealism; no new characters or objects. Restore and enhance crispness and resolution of fine branches, mountains and the character with clean edges and subtle natural detail; retain the quiet luminous blue-white palette, do not oversharpen or add harsh contrast. Full-bleed 16:9 landscape, aim for 3840x2160 high-resolution output. No text, logos, watermark, UI, captions, frames or controls anywhere.

Increase resolution to a 3840x2160 landscape deliverable if supported, using the highest available resolution. Do not alter proportions or move any subjects. Do not add elements or text. No dialogue boxes, controls, watermark, lettering, notifications or borders. Full-bleed clean wallpaper.
note: The image tool returned 1672×941 on both passes. The JPEG is a compressed copy at the same dimensions; no synthetic 4K pixel upsampling was applied.
